C-VIEWER-WINDOW-DRAG.IntentSummary: Add host drag-region metadata to the viewer header/title and the existing no-drag exclusion to the controls. Reuse the host implementation; verify real mouse routing and unchanged table panning.

MustContain.Text: viewer header drags the host window while controls and canvas keep their actions

MustPassCommand.Command: env CI=1 npx --no-install playwright test tests/e2e/table- tests/e2e/block-viewer.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-tables --project=webkit-block-viewer

T-001.Title: Route viewer header dragging through existing host metadata

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Header/title real mouse-down dispatches native start_dragging exactly once. Controls and canvas do not dispatch; native resize-edge and non-primary guards remain effective. Viewer pan, zoom, close/focus and document state remain intact.
